aliases.name: Aliases
aliases.description:
A comma separated <cg>list of aliases</c> to watch for in the comments

Writing an <cy>*@*</c> at the beginning of an alias will make it so you'll only get notified if someone writes a <cl>literal *'@'*</c> at the beginning of the mention

<cb>the *@everyone* alias will be ignored, please use its dedicated setting for it</c>

enable-everyone.name: Notify on @everyone
enable-everyone.description: Get <cg>notified</c> once someone uses the <cy>@everyone</c> alias

use-custom-ids.name: Track Custom Levels
use-custom-ids.description: Track mentions on <cg>any level of your choice</c>

custom-ids.name: Custom Levels
custom-ids.description: A comma separated <cg>list of level IDs</c> that will be checked for

max-notifications.name: Max Notifications
max-notifications.description:
The <co>maximum</c> amount of <cg>notifications</c> you can get <cy>at once</c> before they get <cr>compressed into one</c>

<cb>e.g. if you get 5 mentions and the max is 4, you will only get 1 notification abt it, whereas if you got only 4 you would get all of the 4 notifications</c>

hide-inapropriate-comments.name: Hide Inapropriate Comments
hide-inapropriate-comments.description:
Filter out any comments that contain <co>possibly inapropriate words</c> <c-a6a6a6>(e.g. n word with hard r)</c>

<cb>tysm dc now I'm having to add this cuz of you</c>

hide-spam-comments.name: Hide Spam Comments
hide-spam-comments.description: Filter out any comments that possibly contain <co>spam</c> and/or are flagged as <cr>spam</c> <c-a6a6a6>(so 4+ dislikes)</c>

word-blacklist.name: Word Blacklist
word-blacklist.description: A comma separated <cg>list of words</c> that <cr>will be counted as inappropriate</c>

word-whitelist.name: Word Whitelist
word-whitelist.description: A comma separated <cg>list of words</c> that <cr>will not be counted as inappropriate</c> <c-a6a6a6>(if they are even counted as inappropriate)</c>

user-blacklist.name: User Blacklist
user-blacklist.description:
A comma separated <cg>list of usernames</c> by users who you don't want notifications from

<cb>Suggestion by @SeveralLeaf</c>

refresh-rate.name: Refresh Rate
refresh-rate.description:
The rate in which the mod will request the GD servers (in seconds).

<cr>A low enough refresh rate may cause you to get rate limited, be careful!</c>

ignore-self.name: Ignore Self Mentions
ignore-self.description: Ignore mentions when <co>you're the one that mentioned yourself</c>

show-errors.name: Show Error Notifications
show-errors.description:
In the case a <cr>request fails</c> or any other <co>error</c> occurs, a <cl>notification</c> will appear notifying the error

Useful for catching errors but can be annoying
